summary: A chair explains how members can vote if the online poll will not work for them.
realLife: Graham Murphy explained the 34th Democrats’ endorsement procedure and offered members a text-message alternative to the Zoom poll.
inGame: needs: the meeting’s ballot methods, voter eligibility and whether a ballot is already recorded.

turns.what: The chair directs the member to the announced alternative.
turns.pulledBy: An eligible member cannot submit the online ballot.
turns.writesBack: A single ballot is recorded for that member.

turns.pulledBy: A member has already voted in the poll before texting.
turns.writesBack: The second submission cannot add another vote.
